title: The Lost Lamb
offer: One of the lambs from the cold night is gone! The little one with the black ear. Ask Freya and Liv, they paddle everywhere in their canoe.

steps.say: A lamb with a black ear? We saw one on Laxön, eating Tova's flowers!

steps.load_say: She swam over! Can you imagine? She is wet but well. Take her home.

steps.say: Black Ear! She runs to her mother. Keep the other lamb of that ewe: she likes you.

fact: Sheep can swim, but they do not like it: their wool gets heavy.
